title: WomenLift Health 2027 Eastern Africa Leadership Journey
qualification: Mid- to senior-career women leaders working in health in Eastern Africa
eligibility: Women working in health across Eastern Africa, including Uganda, with a track record of leadership and impact.
description:
WomenLift Health is now accepting applications for the 2027 Eastern Africa Leadership Journey, a fully funded 12-month hybrid leadership development program for mid- to senior-career women leaders in health.

The programme is designed to deepen leadership skills, expand visibility, and build a strong network of peers, mentors, and coaches. Participants also complete in-person residencies and receive support to design and implement a health leadership project.

Ugandan women working in health are eligible if they meet the regional criteria.

## What is on offer

- Fully funded participation
- Mentoring groups with senior leaders
- One-on-one executive coaching
- Leadership assessments
- Two in-person residencies
- Access to a lifelong global fellows network
- Support for a health leadership project

## Important date

Apply by 17 September 2026, 11:59 pm EAT.
